text:
Once upon a time there was a sweet little girl who wore a bright red cloak with a hood every day. Everyone in the village called her Little Red Riding Hood.

One morning, her mother packed a basket of fresh goodies. "Please take these to Grandma — she's feeling poorly today!"

"Remember," said her mother, "go straight through the forest. Don't talk to strangers and don't leave the path!"

"I promise, Mama!" said Red Riding Hood, and off she skipped into the dark green forest, her red cloak bright as a poppy.

Deep in the forest, a sly Big Bad Wolf appeared from behind a tree. "Hello, little girl! Where are you going?" he asked sweetly.

Red Riding Hood forgot her mother's warning. "To Grandma's cottage through the forest!"

The wolf grinned a big toothy grin.

"Why not pick some flowers for your grandmother?" said the wolf with a sly wink. While Red Riding Hood stopped to gather a beautiful bunch of wildflowers, the wolf raced ahead to Grandma's cottage on the other side of the forest.

The wolf knocked on Grandma's door and pretended to be Red Riding Hood. Poor Grandma let him in! The wolf quickly locked Grandma safely in the closet and disguised himself in her bed, wearing her cap and glasses.

Red Riding Hood arrived and knocked. "Come in, my dear!" called the wolf in a squeaky voice. She stepped inside and noticed something strange.

"What big EYES you have, Grandma!" "All the better to see you with!"
"What big EARS!" "All the better to hear you!" "What big TEETH—" "ALL THE BETTER TO EAT YOU!"

Red Riding Hood screamed! Luckily, a brave woodcutter was walking nearby and heard the scream. He burst through the door and chased the wolf far away into the dark forest!

Then he opened the closet and out tumbled Grandma — safe and sound!

Red Riding Hood hugged her grandmother tightly. They sat together and shared all the goodies from the basket. From that day on, Red Riding Hood always kept her mother's advice and never spoke to strangers in the forest.

🌟 THE END 🌟

💡 Moral: Always be careful with strangers!
